# source locations this project does not own and cannot fix: the Windows
# SDK's own winnt.h defines GetCurrentFiber/GetFiberData/NtCurrentTeb via
# FIELD_OFFSET(NT_TIB, ...), which computes a member offset through a
# null-pointer cast -- a member access UBSan's "null" check flags even
# though it is the universally relied-upon, hardware-correct way to read
# the current fiber's Thread Information Block. The check still runs for
# every other source location, Hexal's own generated C included.
